newsitem.title: UK: Racal rallies slightly on results.
newsitem.headline: Racal rallies slightly on results.

text.p: Racal Electronics Plc recovered slightly on Tuesday from Monday's tumble as the company's first-half results statement proved not as gloomy as some had feared after Monday's profit warning.
"The figures were perhaps not as bad as some had thought," said one dealer. Added another: "We are bullish on the stock at its current levels."

Racal also announced an alliance with ITT Defence and Siemens to bid for a 2 billion stg Ministry of Defence communications contract, but warned that the company would shrink if the contract was lost.
The stock was up 5-1/2p at 230-1/2 by 1258 GMT in active trading of 4.7 million shares, after tumbling 50p, or 18 percent, on Monday.
Earlier Racal posted a drop in pre-tax profit to 21.2 million stg from 30.1 million a year before, in line with Monday's warning, and said its full-year profits would be hit by a 20 million charge.
Racal said it expected improved results in fiscal 1998 on the back of a substantial increase in profits from its Data Group unit.
